# Independent Gemma CLI controls

`complete.jsonl` and `empty.jsonl` contain synthetic,hand-authored identities,
clocks,state and memory partitions. `expected.json` fixes independent arithmetic.
They contain no actual inference or quality/adoption/overhead proof. The ordinary
reader requires caller-supplied SHA256 and mandatory framing; Swift schema2
remains separate.

`real-cases.json` is unexecuted finite control/command preparation for the root
queue. Prompt15/output4 are the retained public France witness. Raw-text codec
results and edited-prefix output need independently pinned or fresh-equivalence
evidence; preparation is not a model pass. `reuse-map.json` is conditional scope,
not a completed source-equality attestation. No tests or model jobs are launched
by generating these fixtures.

`logical-history.jsonl` adds an independently authored chunk2 sequence: cancel
after2 of5 prompt rows (5/2/3 state), Continue the existing5-token history to
7/6/1,and Append2 IDs to that7-token history (logical prompt9,final10/9/1).
The input is5/5/9 logical tokens,not suffix counts5/0/2. Complete loss-free
contiguous inventories support attempted-outcome fractions; drops,invalid rows,
export failures or counter overflow leave them null with an explicit reason.

`oracles.json` pins exact earlier published official BF16/G2 controls and paired
raw rows,including the15 codec IDs and [818,5279,529,7001] continuation. The old
collector source matches its recorded input hash. Derived prefixes are labelled;
raw Paris IDs remain explicitly unverified/to-derive. Current CLI execution is
not implied by this oracle preparation. Synthetic summary headers state fixed
route identity while external build/device/content pins and split load/compile/
process-start clocks remain null with reasons.
